description.p: Argos is a simple and fast photo viewer for GNOME. It shows the photos of a folder as a grid, with a folder tree on the side, and opens them in a viewer laid out like gThumb. It follows the desktop theme.

Argos est une visionneuse de photos simple et rapide pour GNOME. Elle montre les photos d'un dossier en grille, avec l'arbre des dossiers à côté, et les ouvre dans une visionneuse disposée comme gThumb. Elle suit le thème du bureau.

Argos ist ein einfacher, schneller Fotobetrachter für GNOME. Er zeigt die Fotos eines Ordners als Raster mit dem Ordnerbaum daneben und öffnet sie in einem Betrachter im Stil von gThumb. Er folgt dem Thema der Arbeitsumgebung.

ul.li: Mouse wheel: next or previous photo; Ctrl + wheel: zoom around the pointer; double click: full screen
Thumbnail strip with an adjustable height, status bar, properties and shooting details (EXIF)
Rotate, crop and save in another format; the original can be restored right after saving
JPEG, PNG, animated GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, SVG, HEIC and AVIF
Molette : photo suivante ou précédente ; Ctrl + molette : zoom autour du pointeur ; double-clic : plein écran
Bande de vignettes réglable en hauteur, barre d'état, propriétés et prise de vue (EXIF)
Pivoter, recadrer et enregistrer sous un autre format ; l'original peut être rétabli juste après
JPEG, PNG, GIF animé, WebP, TIFF, BMP, SVG, HEIC et AVIF
Mausrad: nächstes oder vorheriges Foto; Strg + Mausrad: um den Zeiger zoomen; Doppelklick: Vollbild
Vorschauleiste mit einstellbarer Höhe, Statusleiste, Eigenschaften und Aufnahmedaten (EXIF)
Drehen, zuschneiden und in einem anderen Format speichern; das Original lässt sich gleich danach wiederherstellen
JPEG, PNG, animiertes GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, SVG, HEIC und AVIF
Annotate a photo (A, the pencil button, the context menu): rectangle, ellipse, arrow, line, freehand, highlighter, pixelate and text, with undo
The photo is replaced safely, with Undo right after; date and camera details are kept. Or save it as a new image
Can be turned off in Preferences → Features
A photo opened from the file manager keeps the zoom, rotation or crop started while its folder is still being read
Smooth transition between photos (slide by default, or crossfade) in the slideshow and when browsing with the keyboard or the mouse wheel; can be turned off in the Preferences
Slideshow: F5, the main menu or the context menu; one photo every few seconds (Preferences), Space to pause, Escape to stop
Fullscreen: the navigation arrows and the pointer hide after two seconds and come back near the screen edges or when changing photo
Thumbnail size as a simple choice — small, medium, large, extra large — applied at once; also Ctrl + wheel and + / − in the grid
New “Open Argos on” setting: the last opened folder, the Pictures folder or a chosen folder
Much faster with large folders of high-definition AVIF and HEIC photos: their size is read from the file header instead of decoding the whole image
Coming back to a folder of AVIF photos is instant, the viewer opens them more than twice as fast
The viewer keeps at most 640 MB of decoded photos in memory
Rotating, cropping and Convert / Resize work again on photos whose name or folder contains “%”
Saving a photo opened through a symbolic link changes the real photo and keeps the link
Saving twice in a row while a large photo is being written no longer rotates it twice
Settings are saved again after opening a folder whose name is not UTF-8
Renaming a photo by changing only the case of its name works on FAT / exFAT drives
Convert / Resize (Ctrl+E): resize, rotate and convert one or several photos in one go, the image tools of the Odysseus file manager
Several photos can be selected in the grid (Ctrl / Shift + click, rubber band, Ctrl+A) and moved to the trash, deleted, copied or moved together
Closer to gThumb: the grid shows photos only (folders are in the tree), photos in a white frame, icons at their real size
Folder tree: the folder shown stays selected, and a click also unfolds its subfolders
Much faster grid on big folders: 8,000 images open in about a second, folders already visited instantly
Folder names in the grid are larger, on up to two lines
SVG images fill the window and stay sharp when zooming
Right-click menu on a photo, in the viewer and the grid: full screen, set as background, print, open with, copy image, copy to, move to, rename, move to trash, delete
Folders already visited show up instantly (kept in memory, refreshed in the background)
A photo opened from a file manager goes straight to the viewer
Grid: no more names under the photos, more room for them; smaller loading spinner
First version: photo grid with the folder tree and properties, viewer, adjustable thumbnail strip, simple editing
